basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old environmental science graduate living in Portland, Oregon. During the day, I work as a sustainability consultant, helping businesses reduce their carbon footprints. In my spare time, I enjoy cycling, both for fitness and as an eco-friendly mode of transport. I'm a firm believer in the power of humor to spark change, which is why you'll often find me lurking on r/Jokes. I have a keen interest in personality typology, hence my frequent visits to r/ISTJ. I tend to browse Reddit in the evenings after work, typically around 7-10 PM PST. I'm single and enjoy spending time with my close-knit group of friends, exploring the local food scene and participating in environmental activism.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, which provided me with a solid foundation in ecology, sustainability, and environmental policy. My work as a sustainability consultant has further deepened my understanding of environmental issues and solutions. I'm also an avid reader of environmental literature and follow various online courses to keep my knowledge up-to-date.
